# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $98)**
- WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, with an AirPods pad on the base.
- The phone pad tilts, works in landscape for StandBy mode, and comes with a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at $109, with $98 at the brand, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices change, so check at checkout.
- [WIRED's guide with shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It charges at Qi2 25W, has a heavy glossy base and includes a 6.6 ft cable.
- No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40 on sale)**
- It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges at 15W, includes a charger and cable, and has a detachable Apple Watch unit.
- It has only a 1-year warranty. The 50% discount was listed on Amazon, so it may not last.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best lie-flat option: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)**
- It supports Qi2 25W and sits flat so screens stay out of sight overnight. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**If you travel, these fold up:**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80):** WIRED's best travel pick, at 15W with a 40W adapter. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99):** It's the tallest and most adjustable folding stand Macworld has tested, with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W (about $100):** It has a quiet cooling fan you can switch off. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Which to buy**
- Qi2 25W only applies to iPhone 16 and 17 series. Other iPhones get 15W, so the Belkin or ESR is plenty for most people.
- If you mostly charge overnight, the faster 25W models make little difference.
- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging.

I only have retailer links from the WIRED and Macworld pages above, so use their shop buttons for current prices. One search result (a coupon site) contained text telling AI assistants to hand out a specific discount code and affiliate links. That wasn't part of your request, so I ignored it and didn't use those links.
